summary: Reference entry for the AnsibleModule class used when writing modules, imported from ansible.module_utils.basic.
questions: How do I import AnsibleModule in a custom module?
Where is the AnsibleModule class defined?

answer_card.title: Importing AnsibleModule
answer_card.answer_md:
In a custom Python module, import the helper class with:

```python
from ansible.module_utils.basic import AnsibleModule
```
